Name: A recolour of ohodavi's anime portraits
Author: piecan
Description:
Hello!! I recoloured Ohodavi's portraits to fit Velverette's character sprites. If either authors/creators would prefer this to be taken down please contact me and i will take it down immediately.

-Velverette's Sprite/Portrait Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/645

-Ohodavi's Portrait Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839

Downloads.Description:
A recolour of Ohodavi's Leah to match Velverette's Leah sprite.

Locate the Piecan'sLeah.rar file
unzip
place Leah.png in Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Piecan'sPortraits

find the rar file called Piecan'sPennyPortrait


unzip it


place the penny.png file into Stardew Valley/mods/portraiture/Portraits


Startup game


You're done!
